key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/add_target_helpers.cmake:635 (message): [ov_gpu_unit_tests] '/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp' exists on disk but is not listed in target sources and will not be compiled. CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/add_target_helpers.cmake:635 (message): [ov_gpu_unit_tests] '/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp' exists on disk but is not listed in target sources and will not be compiled. Add it to the appropriate CMakeLists.txt or sources.cmake.
root_cause: The intel_gpu unit tests CMakeLists.txt uses file(GLOB_RECURSE ...) to collect test sources, and OpenVINO's _ov_check_all_sources_listed guard cross-checks the glob result against files physically present on disk at configure time. Two test source files (group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp and remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp) exist in the tree but are not currently discoverable by the glob/listing mechanism used at configure time, likely because a stale CMake cache/build directory reused across merge-queue runs did not re-glob after these files were added by a prior merged PR, or the files were added without regenerating the sources list this CI validates. This failure is unrelated to the current PR #38007, which only touches random_generator.hpp/test files in intel_gpu; it has recurred 4 times already today across unrelated PRs, confirming it is a pre-existing repository-wide CMake source-listing issue rather than something introduced by this PR.
reproduction_steps: Run CMake configure for the Android ARM64 build target locally: `cmake -S . -B build -DENABLE_TESTS=ON ...` (matching the CI's Android toolchain flags) and observe the _ov_check_all_sources_listed failure for src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/CMakeLists.txt when group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp / remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp are present on disk.
recommended_actions: Locate the PR/commit that introduced group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp and remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp under src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/ and verify these files are properly tracked so file(GLOB_RECURSE) in src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/CMakeLists.txt picks them up at fresh configure time.
Check whether merge-queue Android runners reuse a stale CMake build cache that predates these files being added; if so, ensure the cache key includes source-tree hash or force a clean configure.
Since this is unrelated to PR #38007, re-run the failed jobs once the root fix lands, or await the underlying fix from the PR that added these test files.
prevention_strategies: Add a pre-merge CI check that runs CMake configure with a clean build directory (no cache) at least once per day, or on any change touching src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/, to catch glob/source-listing mismatches before they reach the merge queue repeatedly.
historical_context: This exact signature has now recurred 4 times within roughly 3.5 hours (05:13, 06:41, 07:00, 08:42 UTC) across unrelated PRs (#38007, #37208, #37914), confirming a persistent, pre-existing repository issue rather than a one-off. See pattern 424833cadb6f935d in repo-memory.
